summary: Outer Haven: 17 graveled RV sites (1-10 FHU, 11-17 W/E), opened 2025. Only one RV site (17) sells nights online, on Airbnb at $75/night incl. fees (2-night minimum); all RV sites offered at $800/month. Over the $50 gate but GSMNP is 29 km -> gateway exception. Google 5.0 from only 6 reviews. Possible long-stay question for the reviewer.
flags: PRICE: $75/night (Airbnb, $150 for 2 nights April 2027, incl. Airbnb fees, before tax) is over the US$50 gate; gateway exception applies - gateways.py: 'Great Smoky Mountains NP (national park, 29 km)'. No Good Sam listing (discounts not stored). Not a drop on price.

LONG-STAY (reviewer question, not a clear drop): the RV page leads with '***Now offering monthly rates. $800 All RV sites.' and the only RV site sold by the night online is site 17 (Airbnb); the other 16 have no online nightly channel or posted nightly rate. Nightly share can't be measured: at least 1 of 17 sites is sold by the night online; policies (3 pm / 11 am check-in/out, cancellations) read like a transient campground. No wording discourages nightly guests.

PRESENCE: Google 5.0 from only 6 reviews (under 25); Airbnb site 17 4.0 from 1 review; RV Life 4 stars from 1 review (curation_note). New park ('starting March 2025'); own website with phone and email, and a live booking channel (Airbnb instant book) for one RV site.
HOOKUPS: electric amperage not stated anywhere (left absent). Sewer true holds for sites 1-10 only.
